expected_behavior: Welcomes new member and highlights immediate benefits

turns.user_message: I just joined the loyalty program yesterday
What benefits can I use right away?
turns.agent_response:
At the Core tier, you earn Momentum Points and Tier Credits on slots, table games, and dining. These points are redeemable for dining, retail purchases, and hotel stays across the property. Based on available information, you may be eligible for an introductory $10 free play bonus as a new member, which can be verified by visiting a Momentum kiosk or the rewards desk.

With your play history, you might be closer to the next tier than you think—dining credits at Tuscany and SolToro open up at each level, and reaching the Ignite tier at 2,500 credits will add a 10% earn rate bonus. Since it is currently Friday evening, our dining venues will be busy; may I have your name so I can help you find a participating restaurant that fits your preferences for dinner?
